adminOnlyNotice: Processing, approving and paying a run is limited to HR admins. You can review every figure here.

process.heading: Process payroll for {{period}}
process.body1: This computes a payslip for every employee this run covers — earnings, statutory deductions, loan EMIs and approved reimbursements.
process.body2Suffix: , so corrections after this point need the run rejected first.
process.body3: Processing runs synchronously and takes longer the more employees you have. Employees it cannot compute are listed under Errors rather than failing the whole run.

approve.heading: Approve {{period}} payroll
approve.body1Suffix: for this run — salary expense, statutory liabilities and net payable all land in the books.
approve.body2: Check the totals and any held employees first. Approval can still be undone with Reject, but that reverses the journal too.

markPaid.heading: Mark {{period}} payroll as paid
markPaid.body1: Do this once the money has actually left the bank. Every entry in the run is marked paid and the run closes.
markPaid.body2: A paid run can no longer be rejected or cancelled — it is the end of the line.

reject.title: Reject {{period}} payroll?
reject.item1: Loan EMIs deducted by this run are reversed
reject.item2: Reimbursements are unlinked and become claimable again
reject.item3: Every computed payslip entry is deleted
reject.returnsSuffix: so you can fix the data and process it again. Nothing is lost permanently, but the figures on this screen are.

cancel.title: Cancel {{period}} payroll?
cancel.body1: The run is closed as cancelled and drops off the happy path. Any loan EMIs and reimbursements it had claimed are released back to the employees.
cancel.body2: A fresh run can then be created for {{period}} — cancelling is how you start over rather than correct.
